title: Professional summary
summary: Karan is a software and machine learning engineer who combines distributed systems, production-scale data, applied ML, and product development
content: Karan Rajendra is a New York-based software and machine learning engineer. His background combines distributed systems research, production engineering at Meta and Instagram, cloud infrastructure, applied machine learning research, graduate teaching, and end-to-end product development.

title: Education and coursework
summary: Karan has a strong computer engineering and computer science academic foundation
content: Karan is completing a Master of Science in Computer Engineering at Stony Brook University from August 2024 to May 2026 with a 3.9 GPA. His coursework includes Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Distributed Systems, and Advanced Algorithms. He also holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science from Visvesvaraya Technological University.

title: Location and opportunity status
summary: Karan is based in New York and is available for software and machine learning engineering opportunities
content: Karan is based in New York and open to software engineering and machine learning engineering opportunities, including relocation.

title: Meta and Instagram engineering impact
summary: Karan delivered measurable engineering impact on production-scale data at Meta and Instagram
content: As a Software Engineer at Meta and Instagram, Karan built Instagram's first cohort-analysis pipeline and a behavioral clustering framework. The system processed 1.2 billion user pairs, identified 500 million unique users, improved pipeline performance by 5 times, and reduced Business Compute Unit consumption by 50 percent.

title: Product analytics and cross-functional decisions
summary: Karan connected large-scale engineering work to product experiments and decisions
content: At Meta and Instagram, Karan developed Instagram Story interaction signals, multi-signal clustering, and monitoring dashboards for adoption and experiments. His work addressed data sparsity and user segmentation and supported cross-functional product decisions.

title: Distributed systems research
summary: Karan builds reliable distributed backend services and multi-node deployment workflows
content: As a Research Assistant at Stony Brook University, Karan builds distributed backend services in C++ and Python. He improved throughput by 25 percent using multithreading and asynchronous processing, reduced runtime overhead by 20 percent using Linux profiling tools, and developed fault-tolerant microservices with Kafka, gRPC, Docker, replication, and automatic failover.

title: Machine learning and persuasion research
summary: Karan applies modern machine learning and language-model fine-tuning methods to persuasion research
content: Karan's machine learning research includes fine-tuning Llama 2-7B with LoRA and Direct Preference Optimization on r/ChangeMyView data, reaching 0.7 reward accuracy. His research also uses Transformers, PyTorch, WhisperX, and NVIDIA NeMo for large-scale text and multimodal speech analysis.

title: Teaching, mentorship, and communication
summary: Karan demonstrates communication and mentorship through graduate-level distributed systems teaching
content: As a Graduate Teaching Assistant, Karan taught consensus, replication, sharding, fault tolerance, and scalability using Python and C++ implementations. His assignments emphasized system trade-offs, reliability, debugging, and performance optimization and improved project quality by 25 percent.

title: Sentinel counterparty risk system
summary: Sentinel demonstrates rigorous predictive modeling and explainable risk decisions
content: Sentinel benchmarks Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and HistGradientBoosting on 20,000 synthetic longitudinal records using a strict temporal holdout. It achieved 0.724 ROC-AUC and 0.0197 calibrated expected calibration error, and includes Platt scaling, local prediction explanations, a risk action queue, and inverse propensity weighting.

title: Speech emotion detection product
summary: The speech emotion project demonstrates full-stack multimodal machine learning
content: Karan built a full-stack speech emotion journaling application using Keras, Librosa, FastAPI, and React. The classifier uses speech features and a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention architecture across 12,162 source audio clips, predicts eight emotion classes, and achieved 73 percent test accuracy.

title: RoleFit and portfolio assistant products
summary: Karan builds explainable NLP products with user-facing workflows
content: RoleFit is an upload-first resume analyzer with target-role scoring, ATS checks, evidence-safe bullet rewrites, and before-and-after comparison. The AI Portfolio Assistant retrieves cited evidence about Karan's experience, skills, projects, and measurable impact, and abstains when portfolio evidence is insufficient.

title: AWS three-tier book application
summary: Karan built a full-stack three-tier application designed for AWS deployment
content: Karan built a full-stack book management application with a React presentation layer, Node.js and Express REST API, and MySQL data layer. The application supports CRUD workflows, environment-based configuration, and a deployment path using hosted frontend infrastructure, an API service, and Amazon RDS.

title: EKS GitOps Todo application
summary: Karan built a containerized React application with a GitOps delivery workflow
content: Karan built a React Todo application packaged with a multi-stage Docker build and Nginx production image. A CircleCI pipeline builds and pushes versioned images, updates a Kubernetes manifest repository, and supports Argo CD synchronization to Amazon EKS.

content: Karan's core toolkit includes Python, SQL, C++, Java, TypeScript, Scala, Kafka, gRPC, Kubernetes, Terraform, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, FastAPI, Docker, Airflow, GCP, AWS, Azure, and CI/CD.

summary: Karan covers the full applied data science workflow from feature engineering to evaluation
content: Karan's data science capabilities include NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Statsmodels, feature engineering, model evaluation, causal inference, predictive modeling, Matplotlib, Tableau, and Power BI. His work demonstrates deep learning, NLP, multimodal ML, calibration, and explainability.

content: Karan's backend and data platform experience includes C++, Python, Kafka, gRPC, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, Spark, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, HDFS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Airflow, GCP, AWS, Azure, and CI/CD.
